---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

### The problem

What you are trying to do that is currently hard or impossible. Describe the
situation rather than the solution — the best fix is often not the one first
imagined.

### Proposed solution

What you would like to see. API sketch or example usage if you have one.

### Alternatives considered

Workarounds you tried, and why they are not enough.

### Who this affects

Just you, or a class of consumers? Is it specific to one backend (CentralNic
Reseller, Internet.bs, Moniker) or shared across them? A breaking change to existing
behaviour, or purely additive?

### Additional context

Links to related issues, upstream API documentation, or a Jira ticket if one exists.

> This SDK is deliberately lightweight and its source is pinned to PHP 8.3 language
> features, because it ships into ionCube-encoded WHMCS installations. A proposal
> that needs a new dependency or newer syntax is not out of the question, but it
> does need to earn both.
